remarks: Fully renovated 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment in a two-family home in Greenwich. This bright and updated unit features a newly renovated kitchen, brand new bathroom, beautifully refinished hardwood floors, and a new heating and cooling system with central air. The apartment has been freshly painted throughout and offers a comfortable and functional living space with the convenience of an in unit washer and dryer. Additional highlights include a private deep electric garage space and a long shared driveway providing ample off street parking. The unit also offers pull down attic stairs leading to additional storage space. Conveniently located near Hamilton Avenue with easy access to downtown Greenwich, Metro-North, shops, and restaurants. Pets considered with fee. Landlord covers water and landscaping. Tenant responsible for other utilities. Credit and background check required. Strong credit and income verification preferred. Available for immediate occupancy.
